accepted_artifact_action.on_all_gates_passed: Report recommends the swap; src/ossp_router/resources/budget-brake-router.v1.json is replaced only after an explicit human approval step recorded in docs.
accepted_artifact_action.on_any_gate_failed: Keep the current bundled artifact untouched.

context_frozen.why_forest_only: Cost heads determine premium rows and parent allocation; leaving them frozen guarantees Fast/Balanced stay bit-identical and inherits every budget safety constant. Only the Premium K1 promotion order can change.
context_frozen.xtrees_recipe: Identical to research/export/brake_artifact.py: n_estimators=200, max_depth=4, min_samples_leaf=20, max_features=1.0, criterion='squared_error', bootstrap=False, n_jobs=1, random_state=20260816; target=scores[:,2]-scores[:,1]; sample_weight=min(generations[:,1],generations[:,2]); features=ossp_router.cost_calibrated_router.structural_features/14; clip [-1,1].

decision_reasons.fail: A safety or contract gate failed on the full-public refit. Keep the current Train-fitted artifact.
decision_reasons.pass: All acceptance gates passed. The candidate artifact is recommended for the bundled resource pending human approval; this is a final fit, not a model-selection result.

gates.fast_balanced_identity: Fast and Balanced decisions from the candidate artifact must equal the bundled artifact byte-for-byte on Train and Dev replays.
gates.g1_contract_load: budget_brake_router.load_artifact_mapping accepts the candidate without error.
gates.g2_determinism: Two independent Dev replays of the candidate produce identical model tuples.
gates.g3_predicted_brake: Predicted Premium ratio <= 3.25 on every evaluated batch (inherited by construction; asserted).
gates.g4_actual_budget: Actual Premium ratio < 3.80 on Train replay, Dev replay, and all ten pooled single-family batches.
gates.g5_dev_floor: Candidate Dev replay final score >= 0.669517045455 (in-sample floor; falling below the current pin indicates a harness or fit fault, and the candidate is rejected).
gates.note: No score-based candidate selection happens here: the recipe is frozen and only grows its training set from 1,760 to 2,640 episodes.

mandate.organizer_rules: docs/CHALLENGE_RULES.md lines 14-15 and 107-121: public Train/Dev prompts and outcomes may be used for training and optimization; fitted classifiers, coefficients and lookup structures may ship in the image. Final evaluation must use the same router program and learning files validated on public Train/Dev.
mandate.plan_reference: docs/competitor-strategy-report-2026-08-21.md sections 5 and 9.7 scheduled 'config freeze, full-public refit' for the final artifact.
mandate.scope_guard: Every honest-score leader ships heads fitted on the full public pool; Scrooge is the only team shipping Train-only heads.

seed_note: No folds and no seeds: this is a deterministic single refit plus deterministic replay checks.
